lead.event: IDX tightens IPO and main-board listing requirements
lead.headline: IDX tightens IPO and Main Board rules, requiring five-year projections
lead.blurb: The Indonesia Stock Exchange revised its listing rules, removing the minimum public offering price and raising financial requirements for prospective issuers. Applicants must provide equity research reports and summary listing-application information, while Main Board companies must maintain retained earnings. BEI said the changes aim to strengthen issuer fundamentals and operational readiness, and removing the price minimum could help fundraising and make shares more affordable. Issued on 7 October after OJK approval, the rules took effect on 9 October.

deals_control.event: Haji Isam completes acquisition of a 30.25% stake in Bayan Resources
deals_control.headline: Haji Isam completes acquisition of 30.25% of BYAN
deals_control.blurb: Through Jhonlin Baratama, Haji Isam bought about 10.08 billion shares from Low Tuck Kwong and Elaine Low at Rp2,588 each, for Rp26.09 trillion. The deal closed on 7 October, leaving Low with 9.95% and Elaine with 22.05%; Bayan said it did not change BYAN’s control.

deals_control.event: BIKE acquires a 72% stake in Berau Usaha Mandiri
deals_control.headline: BIKE acquires 72% of Berau Usaha Mandiri
deals_control.blurb: Bhineka Inovasi Ketahanan Energi completed the acquisition through subsidiary Prambanan Nusantara Energi on 8 October. Berau Usaha Mandiri holds a roughly 500-hectare mining area with about 22 million metric tons of proven coal reserves, and BIKE targets annual production of 1.5–2.5 million metric tons.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: United Tractors allocates Rp5.6 trillion for 2026 share buybacks
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: UNTR allocates Rp5.6 trillion for 2026 share buybacks
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: United Tractors repurchased 57.97 million shares for Rp1.42 trillion from 1 July to 30 September, using 71.2% of that period’s Rp2 trillion budget. It plans another Rp2 trillion in buybacks from 1 October to 31 December, funded entirely from internal cash.

other.event: Danantara says WIKA's Rp34 trillion debt prolongs restructuring
other.headline: Danantara says WIKA's Rp34 trillion debt prolongs restructuring
other.blurb: COO Dony Oskaria said Wijaya Karya's assets are insufficient to reduce its debt, and Danantara rejects simply extending maturities to 30–40 years. It is seeking fundamental reform and is also weighing legacy issues, including receivables tied to the high-speed rail project.

other.event: Pefindo assigns idCCC rating to PTPP bonds
other.headline: Pefindo assigns idCCC rating to PTPP bonds worth Rp1.99 trillion
other.blurb: The rating is effective 5 October to 7 January 2027. Pefindo says the bonds are vulnerable to default and depend on better business and financial conditions. Bond and sukuk holders did not approve proposed changes or payment deferrals at 1–2 September meetings, and Pembangunan Perumahan is coordinating to reconvene them.

earnings_guidance.event: United Tractors records Rp2.75 trillion impairment at Rantau Dedap project
earnings_guidance.headline: UNTR records Rp2.75 trillion impairment at Rantau Dedap project
earnings_guidance.blurb: United Tractors is assessing recovery steps after Rantau Dedap output fell from an expected about 90 MW to 50–55 MW by June 2026 as steam generation declined. The impairment covered a Rp1.47 trillion equity investment and Rp1.28 trillion in subordinated shareholder loans, both reduced to zero. The project has met debt payments and delivered nearly 100% of its 90% contractual electricity obligation.

earnings_guidance.event: United Tractors targets higher second-half gold, coal, and equipment sales
earnings_guidance.headline: UNTR targets higher second-half sales, with gold at 45,000 ounces
earnings_guidance.blurb: United Tractors targets PT Agincourt Resources gold sales of 45,000 ounces, up from 15,000 in the first half, and own-mine coal sales of 4 million tons after its quota rose to 12.4 million tons from 7.5 million. Komatsu sales fell 27% to 1,994 units, while the company kept its 2026 target at 4,000 units.

earnings_guidance.event: BRI Danareksa raises Medco profit estimates and target price
earnings_guidance.headline: BRI Danareksa raises MEDC profit estimates and target to Rp2,300
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI Danareksa raised 2026-28 net profit forecasts by 27%, 51% and 62%, to US$492 million, US$634 million and US$672 million, and lifted its target from Rp2,200 while retaining Buy. Higher contributions from Amman Mineral and oil-price assumptions underpin the upgrade. Medco expects Sambar to begin partial production in Q4 2026.
